By signing, I acknowledge that I have read and understand the following:

1. **What the program is.** First Offer Academy is a 12-week coaching and instruction program for my student's internship search: weekly 90-minute group sessions, weekly 15-minute 1:1s, an accountability pod, feedback on their work, graded mock interviews, parent progress reports every two weeks, and a Week 12 family meeting.
2. **No promised outcome.** First Offer Academy does not promise internship offers or any specific outcome. Hiring decisions belong to employers.
3. **My student's effort matters.** Results depend heavily on my student completing the weekly minimums. If my student misses their minimums two weeks in a row, First Offer Academy will set up a call with my student and me.

5. **Recordings.** My student will record practice answers and mock interviews for feedback. These are not published without separate written permission (see the Testimonial & Media Release).
